scope: R141 single-profile generic PGO Oracle screen; no router acceptance
primary: For each CPU pair separately, form the equal-weight geometric mean of five mean latency ratios within each block. Both pairs must have four-block median below 0.99 and at least three blocks below 1.
latency_veto: Any of 2 CPU pairs x 2 affinities x 5 lanes x 3 metrics with ratio median above 1.03 and all four blocks above 1 rejects the candidate.
numeric: Individual ratios use exact raw-sample fractions. Geometric means use 60-digit Decimal arithmetic rounded to 30 decimal places before median and strict comparisons.
interpretation: Paired median changes within inclusive plus/minus 1% are unresolved, never equivalence or a clearly material improvement. Equal weights are an engineering choice, not a real traffic mix. CPU is reported only; no wall-minus-CPU cause inference.
stopping: Exactly one frozen profile-use ELF and 240 cases. If either primary fails or any veto fires, stop this PGO direction: no retraining, profile selection, variants, excluded blocks, retries or extra samples to rescue it.
router: A passed screen only permits separate consideration of an independent seven-lane router comparison with exact-PGO correctness and resource gates. No R140 functional, timing or memory result is transferred to PGO.
